| **IND_1103** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_impressions_today` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] How many times the user saw the screen containing this button today. | Denominator for calculating true Click-Through Rate (CTR). | Baseline | Measures UI visibility |
| **IND_1104** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_clicks_today` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] Exact number of times the user tapped this button today. | Measures immediate daily usage of this specific control. | +15% active engagement | Tracks daily hot buttons |
| **IND_1105** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_clicks_7d` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] Total taps on this button over the last 7 days. | Identifies the user's favorite weekly buttons and workflows. | +20% weekly habit | Ranks Most-Clicked Buttons |
| **IND_1106** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_clicks_30d` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] Total taps on this button over the last 30 days. | Long-term feature value indicator. | +25% monthly retention | Identifies core power-user controls |
| **IND_1107** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_ctr_pct_7d` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] Percentage of times seeing this button's screen resulted in clicking this button. | Separates buttons that are popular only because they are on the Home screen from truly high-intent buttons. | +18% UX efficiency | Optimizes button placement |
| **IND_1108** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_zero_click_dead_button_flag` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] True if the user has opened the screen containing this button 10+ times but NEVER clicked this button once! | Answers your exact question: Which buttons are never clicked at all by users! | -10% dead UI clutter | Either highlight with a gold pulse or redesign/remove |
| **IND_1109** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_first_click_latency_ms` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] Milliseconds between the screen opening and the user tapping this button. | Fast click (<1,000ms) = instinctive muscle memory; slow click (>15,000ms) = hesitation or hard-to-find button. | +12% UI clarity | Measures visual hierarchy |

| **IND_1111** | `btn_nav_tab_0_home_error_after_click` | [Bottom Nav Tab 0: Home Dashboard] Times tapping this button resulted in an error snackbar, validation failure, or failed API call. | Pinpoints buttons that disappoint the user right after they click. | -40% broken flow | Immediate action-reaction recovery hook |

## Matrix 7: 65-Symbol Trading Psychology, Win-Probability & Margin Hunger


### NSE Index & F&O — NIFTY 50 Index (Lot Size: 75)

| ID | Indicator Name | What It Measures (Plain English) | What It Tells Us About the Customer | Impact on Return Tomorrow | Impact on Paying Conversion |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **IND_2853** | `sym_nifty_chart_views_7d` | [NIFTY 50 Index (Lot Size: 75)] Times user opened the chart for this symbol in the last 7 days. | Shows strong interest in this specific ticker. | +15% engagement | Use this ticker in personalized push alerts |
| **IND_2854** | `sym_nifty_trades_placed_today` | [NIFTY 50 Index (Lot Size: 75)] Number of buy/sell orders placed on this symbol today. | Measures active daily trading focus. | +30% D+1 return | High virtual cash turnover |
| **IND_2855** | `sym_nifty_trades_won_7d` | [NIFTY 50 Index (Lot Size: 75)] Number of profitable closed trades on this symbol in 7 days. | Identifies the user's 'Lucky / Comfort Stock' where they make money. | +40% retention | Pitch Wealth Multiplier pack after wins here |
| **IND_2856** | `sym_nifty_trades_lost_7d` | [NIFTY 50 Index (Lot Size: 75)] Number of losing trades closed on this symbol in 7 days. | Identifies the stock that is draining the user's virtual wallet. | -20% frustration risk | Route away from this stock after 2 losses |
